#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> fac;

int powmod(int b, long long e, int mod) {
    int ans = 1;
    b %= mod;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1)
            ans = (1LL * ans * b) % mod;
        e >>= 1;
        b = (1LL * b * b) % mod;
    }
    return ans;
}

int nCr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    long long ans = fac[n];
    long long de = (1LL * fac[n - r] * fac[r]) % MOD;
    de = powmod((int)de, MOD - 2, MOD);
    return (int)((ans * de) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    fac.resize(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        fac[i] = (1LL * fac[i - 1] * (i % MOD)) % MOD;

    int pop = n - (int)k;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= pop; ++i) {
        long long notPop = (1LL * nCr(pop, i) * powmod(pop - i, n, MOD)) % MOD;
        if (i & 1) notPop = (-notPop) % MOD;
        ans = (ans + notPop + MOD) % MOD;
    }
    ans = (1LL * ans * nCr(n, pop)) % MOD;
    if (k != 0)
        ans = (ans * 2) % MOD;

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
